sketches.mechanism: Ownership transfer (move semantics) — once a value is moved, the original binding becomes inaccessible and cannot be used again
sketches.resonance: Giving yourself to someone means you no longer belong to yourself; the compiler enforces that what is given cannot be taken back.

sketches.mechanism: weak references — a weak var automatically becomes nil when the referenced object is deallocated, requiring optional unwrapping to access
sketches.resonance: A memory held weakly will fade on its own; you must always check whether it still exists before you can reach it.

sketches.mechanism: A goroutine sending on an unbuffered channel blocks forever if no receiver exists, causing a fatal deadlock
sketches.resonance: A voice that speaks with no one listening doesn't echo — it stops the world.
